_comment: THE MAINTAINER'S OWN ALIASES — not yours. Maps short aliases to sets of project names as they appear in event logs (directory basenames). Used by cartographer-search.sh --project, /focus, cartographer-feed.sh, cartographer-pulse.sh, and build-profile.js. Not git-specific — any project that produces JSONL events can be listed.
_adopters: These names describe someone else's machine, and an alias that is not defined falls through as a literal project name rather than erroring — so scoping to one of these gets you zero results for a scope you think you set. Run `node scripts/bootstrap-project-registry.js --dry-run` to derive your own from your event logs; it writes to ~/.config/session-cartographer/project-registry.json, which REPLACES this file (the layers do not merge). Do not edit this file to fix your install — an update overwrites it.
